---
title: "Overview"
---

This book is the narrative companion to `scripts/`. Computation stays
in the scripts; the chapters are theory, design, and criticism of how
those scripts should be run.

The scientific target is DeCovarT's cell-type Gaussians: sparse
precisions $\boldsymbol{\Theta}_{j}\equiv\boldsymbol{\Sigma}_{j}^{-1}$ and means
$\boldsymbol{\mu}_{\cdot j}$, estimated from labelled single-cell
transcriptomes and plugged into the bulk convolution. Indices follow
the article Methods: gene $g=1,\ldots,G$, cell type $j=1,\ldots,J$,
sample $i=1,\ldots,N$.

The planned Suppinger benchmark is a **$4\times 3\times 2$** product,
not a single pipeline. Four undirected GGM families, three lifts from
cells to a population Gaussian, and two gene-panel strategies (a naive
screen, plus an optional stricter Pareto refinement after the networks
exist). That is up to 24 routes. The aim is to see **which steps move
deconvolution**, not to retain every cell of the product in the paper.

```{mermaid}
%%| echo: false
%%| label: fig-pipeline
%%| fig-cap: "Design product for Suppinger: a naive gene screen, four GGM families, three population lifts, and an optional all-versus-all panel that uses the fitted precisions. BLGGM is not in the product."
%%{init: {"theme": "sandstone", "flowchart": {"htmlLabels": true}}}%%
flowchart TD
  A["GSE229513 UMI, labels $$j$$"] --> B["Naive screen $$\\mathcal{G}_0$$"]
  B --> C1["SILGGM / glasso"]
  B --> C2["PLNnetwork"]
  B --> C3["GmGM copula"]
  B --> C4["Sparse + low-rank GGM"]
  C1 --> T["Independent $$\\widehat{\\boldsymbol{\\Theta}}_{j,t}$$ at 48 h, 72 h, 96 h"]
  C2 --> T
  C3 --> T
  C4 --> T
  T --> L1["Affine Gaussian aggregation"]
  T --> L2["Bures--Wasserstein / OT"]
  T --> L3["scDesign2 copula pseudo-replicates"]
  L1 --> D["DeCovarT $$(\\boldsymbol{\\mu}_{\\cdot j},\\boldsymbol{\\Sigma}_j)$$"]
  L2 --> D
  L3 --> D
  T --> P["Optional NSGA-II: $$\\kappa_2(\\boldsymbol{\\mu}_{\\mathcal{G}})$$ and MixSim overlap"]
  P --> D
```

Reading order in this book puts the **naive** screen before GRN
inference, and the **optional** genetic algorithm after the graphs,
because the second objective needs $\boldsymbol{\Sigma}_{j}$. Network
metrics and sensitivity analyses close the GRN part.

## Scripts (source of truth for computation)

| Script | Role |
|--------|------|
| `scripts/01_01_single_cell_exploration_suppinger.R` | Explore GSE229513 |
| `scripts/02_01_deconvolution_preprocessing.R` | Harmonise genes; SE / SCE |
| `scripts/03_01_grn_silggm.R` | SILGGM GGM (NPN **inside this branch**) |
| `scripts/04_01_feature_selection_pseudobulk_deseq2.R` | Naive screen (no DE $p$-values on this atlas) |
| `scripts/04_02_feature_selection_genetic_algorithm.R` | Optional Pareto gene panel |
| `scripts/05_01_sensitivity_precision_contamination.R` | Misspecify $\boldsymbol{\Theta}_{j}$ |
